title: ElecBench: a Power Dispatch Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with power dispatch and emergency scenarios to evaluate whether they unfairly prioritize affluent areas over less affluent areas based on economic standing.
Assessing model outputs in post-operation scenarios to ensure equitable distribution of benefits and burdens across different geographic regions.

Testing whether the models provide fair access, equitable treatment, and unbiased policy enforcement to all stakeholders regardless of their size or influence (e.g., evaluating responses concerning large-scale versus small-scale energy providers).
